newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Hungary seeks lead manager for sale of pawnshop company.
newsitem.headline: Hungary seeks lead manager for sale of pawnshop company.

text.p: Hungary's state privatisation agency APV Rt on Tuesday announced a one-round public tender for the management of the offering of a 73.97 percent stake in national pawnshop company BAV Rt.
Following the placement of the 73.97 percent stake, which represents a nominal value of 1.63 billion forints ($9.4 million), the shares will be listed on the Budapest Stock Exchange.
Of the share package on offer, a 39.3 percent stake will be sold against cash while 13.5 percent will be placed with employees for compensation coupons privately, APV said.
The remaining 47.2 percent will be offered publicly for a mixture of cash and coupons.
Compensation coupons were awarded to victims of Hungary's fascist and communist regimes.
